title: C Minor Piano Chord (Cm): Notes, Inversions & PDF
description: Learn the C minor piano chord: C, E-flat and G. Compare Cm/E-flat and Cm/G, check the major-minor difference and print the keyboard diagrams.
user_task: Locate this exact triad and compare its three bass positions.
questions: Is Cm/E-flat a different chord from Cm?
Can I replace E-flat with D-sharp in the label?
Does the C minor chord contain every note of the C minor scale?
Are the finger numbers used for every inversion?

blocks.heading: Notes and keyboard position
blocks.body: C minor is C, E-flat and G. The lowered third, E-flat, distinguishes Cm from the C–E–G major triad. The displayed root-position example is C4–E♭4–G4. Numbers after note letters identify octaves, not fingers. Use the diagram, note list and bass label together; Play chord sounds the selected notes together, while the note-by-note control sounds them from low to high.
blocks.evidence_status: [已核实] rules; [推断] register and original teaching example

blocks.heading: What to notice
blocks.body: C and G remain on white keys, while E-flat uses the black key between D and E. E-flat is the chord’s third: the letter E matters to the spelling. D-sharp can use the same physical key in equal temperament, but it is not the spelling used for the third of a C minor triad. C to E-flat spans three semitones; C to G spans seven. In the formula 1–♭3–5, the flat means the third is lowered relative to a major triad on the same root. It does not mean the root C becomes C-flat.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] original explanation from preserved note data and cited rules

blocks.heading: Compare three positions
blocks.body: Read each bass note before selecting a position. The root-position example starts with C; first inversion starts with E♭; second inversion starts with G. The chord tones stay the same. These are independently chosen reference registers, not an ascending exercise. Switching a position must update the selected note order, diagram, sound and current-print snapshot together. Hand numbers, when available, apply only to the root example.
blocks.evidence_status: [推断] derived inversion explanation; controls are implementation acceptance requirements
